description: List translation label keys on a branch, optionally filtered by namespace (a dotted key prefix, so "checkout" matches "checkout.title") and/or status. Returns each label's key, status and tags; pass include_values=true to also get the per-language translation strings. Use this to browse or enumerate keys. Values are omitted by default to keep the response small. When include_values is true and more than 300 labels match, only the first 300 are returned with a note; narrow the result using the namespace filter. Reads the token's base branch unless `branch` names another allowed branch.

branch.description: Branch to operate on. Defaults to the token's base (bound) branch. May name any branch in the token's allowed set: its base branch, plus branches this token created (only when the token's scope is create-own; see list_branches). Naming any other branch fails with branch_not_allowed.

include_values.description: Include the per-language translation values (defaults to false).

namespace.description: Only keys beginning with "<namespace>." (a dotted prefix).

status.description: Only labels carrying this exact status string.

name: list_labels
title: List Labels
